auth.description:
To link your Telldus Live account:
1. Open the link below
2. Log in to Telldus Live
3. Authorize **{app_name}** (select **Yes**).
4. Come back here and select **Submit**.

[Link Telldus Live account]({auth_url})
auth.title: Authenticate with Telldus Live

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address to Tellstick Net or Tellstick ZNet for local API.

command_failed.message: Telldus Live did not accept the command

error.retry_delay_order: The initial retry delay must not be longer than the maximum retry delay.

init.title: Telldus Live options
init.description: Telldus Live limits how many requests are accepted. When a request fails, it is retried with an increasing delay.

data_description.retry_initial_delay: Seconds to wait before the first retry. The delay doubles on each failure.
data_description.retry_max_delay: Longest wait in seconds between retries.
data_description.request_delay: Seconds to wait between the per-device requests made when a device is first seen.
